title: Pairing scan messages
responsibility: Map known scan failures to readable notices and validate a phone display name.

inputs.name: scanFailure.cause
inputs.description: Value rejected by the pairing scan; an object's code is checked against the known scan-failure codes. Non-objects and unrecognized codes produce null.

inputs.name: scanNotice.cause
inputs.description: Value rejected by the pairing scan; a recognized object code maps to its notice, while any other cause is converted with String(cause).

inputs.name: phoneName.value
inputs.description: Phone label supplied for the device; surrounding whitespace is trimmed before validation. An empty result or a trimmed string longer than 80 JavaScript string code units returns null.

outputs.name: scanFailures
outputs.description: Readonly list of remote scan-failure codes used by scanFailure to recognize rejected causes; it is assigned from remoteScanFailures.

outputs.name: nameNotice
outputs.type: "Give this phone a name of up to 80 characters."
outputs.description: Fixed instruction for naming this phone; it tells the person to use a name of at most 80 characters.
examples: Give this phone a name of up to 80 characters.

outputs.name: scanNotices
outputs.description: Maps every RemoteScanFailure code to the text shown for that way a scan ends without an offer.

examples.camera-denied: Camera access is off for Harness. Turn it on in Settings, then scan again.
examples.camera-unavailable: This device has no camera that can scan a code.
examples.scan-cancelled: Scanning was cancelled. Nothing was sent.
examples.offer-invalid: That is not a Harness pairing code. Scan the code under Pair a phone on your computer.
examples.offer-unsupported: That code is for another version of Harness. Update Harness on both, then scan again.
examples.offer-environment: That code is for a relay this build of Harness does not accept.
examples.offer-expired: That code has expired. Choose New code on your computer and scan again.

outputs.name: scanFailure
outputs.description: Returns the cause's code when it exactly matches an entry in scanFailures; returns null for other causes.

outputs.name: scanNotice
outputs.description: Returns the mapped notice for a recognized scan failure; otherwise returns String(cause).
examples: Camera access is off for Harness. Turn it on in Settings, then scan again.

outputs.name: phoneName
outputs.description: Returns the trimmed name when it is nonempty and its JavaScript string length is at most 80; otherwise returns null.
